Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Content Designer (Conversational AI) position. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I have developed a strong foundation in crafting user-centered content that improves discoverability and engagement. My experience includes writing keyword-targeted blog content, designing website structures, and implementing structured data to enhance AI search visibility.

While my current role focuses on SEO and web content, I am eager to apply my skills to conversational design. I have a keen interest in how users interact with AI and have hands-on experience with GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), which involves optimizing content for AI-powered platforms. I am confident in my ability to design natural, helpful dialogue flows and maintain a consistent tone of voice.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and am comfortable with hybrid or remote work. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with a working knowledge of Dutch (B1), and I am committed to continuous learning.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills align with your team's goals. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Content Designer (Conversational AI) role. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), I have developed a unique perspective on how content can be crafted to serve both human users and AI systems. I am eager to bring this perspective to conversational design, where the goal is to create intuitive, natural, and helpful interactions.

In my current role at Episto, I own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing. I write keyword-targeted blog content that grows organic traffic, and I build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra. This experience has taught me the importance of clear, user-centered content that is also structured for discoverability. I have also implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema) and entity optimization on my own project, mirook.com, to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This hands-on work with GEO has given me insight into how AI interprets and presents content, which is directly relevant to designing conversational experiences.

I am particularly drawn to this role because it combines content strategy, UX writing, and AI technology. I am confident in my ability to design conversational flows, write clear and engaging dialogue, and maintain a consistent tone of voice. I am also familiar with accessibility principles and inclusive design, and I am eager to apply them to conversational content.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and am open to hybrid or remote work. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with a working knowledge of Dutch (B1), and I am committed to continuous improvement. I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to your team and help shape exceptional AI-powered experiences.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing this role further.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
